question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Made his mark
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. To distinguish himself.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"Made his mark"** means to achieve something notable or to become recognized for one's accomplishments. (अपनी छाप छोड़ना)
 
 
• **Example: **He made his mark in the industry by creating innovative software solutions.
 
 

 
• **Distinguish himself** refers to someone making themselves notable or remarkable in some way. (अपना नाम कमाना)
 
 
• **Example: **She distinguished herself in the competition with her outstanding performance.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2 i.e. To distinguish himself**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **To make a colourful exit** (धूमधाम से बाहर निकलना): To leave in a noticeable or dramatic way.
 
 
• **Example:** He made a colourful exit from the party, dancing and singing.
 
 

 
• **To take a stand** (मजबूती से अपने विचार रखना): To assert an opinion or position firmly.
 
 
• **Example: **She decided to take a stand against the unfair policies at work.
 
 

 
• **To fail in the task** (कार्य में असफल होना): To not succeed in completing a task.
 
 
• **Example:** Despite his efforts, he failed in the task assigned to him.
